title: 4-Billion-Year-Old Martian Meteorite Discovered in Sahara
summary: A 4.1-billion-year-old rock found in the Sahara Desert is one of the oldest Martian meteorites ever discovered.

summary: At SEMICON Europa 2026, Europe's semiconductor industry will confront a combination of competitive, technological, and geopolitical pressures.

summary: Recent developments include HBM smuggling routes into China, Micron pausing Taiwan fab work, and Samsung expanding base-die capacity.

title: New Framework Automates Nanoparticle Image Screening

title: Agility Robotics Closes First Trading Day on Nasdaq
summary: Humanoid developer Agility Robotics ended its first day of trading on the Nasdaq at $11.49, up 2 percent.

title: Output-Feedback Integral Sliding-Mode Extremum Seeking Developed
summary: Researchers developed a dither-free extremum-seeking controller for nonlinear dynamic systems with unknown steady-state performance maps.

title: China Blocks SoftBank’s $5.4B Acquisition of ABB Robotics
summary: Chinese regulators halted the acquisition citing concerns over the potential transfer of robot data for AI training.
